The graph format changes (71); the first start after the upgrade rebuilds the graph.

## Fixes

- **`glasir review`** lists every hop of a large change again. Since 0.13.0 it read only the first page of 200 dependents, so the comment lost hops its own header still counted. It now asks for the largest page, counts each hop in full and says when hops lie further out.
- **`glasir review --depth 0`** runs one hop again instead of failing on the minimum the schema declares for `depth`.
- **`detect_changes`** counts what its text leaves out from the full number, not from the 20 it shows, so a small `limit` no longer prints a wrong remainder or none. Each entry of `hops` carries `count`, the dependents at that hop across all pages.
- A Swift type that names an Objective-C class keeps its reference, as a Swift call of it already linked.

## Install

- Homebrew: `brew install attackwave/glasir/glasir`
- Scoop: add the bucket `Attackwave/scoop-glasir`, then run `scoop install glasir`
